name: Meine Ausweiskopie
tagline: Redact and mark German id copies
blurb: Easily watermark and hide information in copies of your (German) identity documents!
description:
Easily watermark and hide information in copies of your (German) identity documents!

This tool allows watermarking copies of German identity documents.
You can also redact information your recipient does not need (like the document number or CAN).

Dieses Werkzeug ermöglicht es eine Ausweiskopie eindeutig als Kopie und mit Wasserzeichen zu kennzeichnen.
Für den Adressaten unwichtige Daten (z. B. die CAN oder die Ausweisnummer) können geschwärzt werden.

Currently, this tool supports the following documents:

• Temporary German identity cards (issued on paper)

• Regular German identity cards (all revisions)

• German Passports (issued 2017 or newer)

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
